definition.text: Runner; wild ass, one of the antediluvian patriarchs, the father of Mehujael (Gen. 4:18), and grandson of Cain.

works.title: Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 1, Volume 2: Augustine — The City of God and On Christian Doctrine

chapters.title: How It is that Cain’s Line Terminates in the Eighth Generation, While Noah, Though Descended from the Same Father, Adam, is Found to Be the Tenth from Him
